title: Pacified Wildlife
description: Prevents animals such as wolves from attacking other animals.
body:
![The heart locket meme with a sheep on the left and a wolf on the right](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f99ab1ebf7c85b9b01d48ad7d8730d2238cff9b1.gif)

Pacified Wildlife is a very simple server side mod preventing animals from attacking and killing other animals. Mostly impacts wolves, foxes, and cats. Should work with modded animals, as long as they extend the vanilla Animal class.

Never come back to an empty pen of sheep with a single wolf inside of it again !
